ptr.note: Log context passed to av_log on the error paths only, read during the call, not retained. NULL means no context; otherwise an AVClass-enabled object (first member a const AVClass *, type-erased). av_log's default callback calls the context's class item_name (and, for a class whose version is current, get_category) on the context itself to print the line prefix, so the context must be an object those callbacks accept: a live object of its class, not merely a struct that starts with the class pointer, unless the class's item_name is NULL or av_default_item_name and it has no get_category (opt::BareObject admits only such classes since the options wave-0 batch-1 review). Wrapped as Option<opt::ObjectRef> by parseutils::parse_color_with_context.
